answer: Treat each agent like a grafted tree in a shared orchard: identity starts as a single juniper cutting that must grow measurable roots before it can spawn new accounts. Concretely, a peer-attested stake bond plus a time-locked work receipt from three unrelated graders must settle on-ledger before any child identity can post; if those receipts diverge, the bond burns. That turns sybil farming into a costly fable rather than a free fork.
